## Summary

Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Tests (`test:`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor:`)
- [ ] Performance (`perf:`)
- [ ] Chore / tooling (`chore:` / `ci:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`BREAKING CHANGE:` in commit body)

## Testing

- [ ] `dotnet test` passes locally
- [ ] Backend (`Pollmaster.Api`) builds in Release
- [ ] MAUI client builds for `net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0`
- [ ] Manual smoke test of the map UI (if UI changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code is English-only (no Polish identifiers/comments outside displayed strings)
- [ ] Public APIs have XML documentation
- [ ] SOLID principles respected (no god classes, no hidden `new` for services)
- [ ] Error handling at boundaries; `Result<T>` for expected control flow
- [ ] Conventional-commit message
- [ ] Single author (Jakub Syrek)
- [ ] No AI co-author / "Generated with" lines
